remarks: Sophisticated, resort-style living in Stamford's desirable Springdale neighborhood. This beautifully updated three-level townhome-style condo offers a flexible, light-filled floor plan with hardwood floors, complete with a private elevator serving all three levels for effortless access throughout the home. The first level features a comfortable family room, ideal for relaxing, and a few steps from the attached garage and entrance. The main level is the heart of the home, with an open, updated eat-in kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, a gas stove, and a center island, all flowing into the living and office areas with a fireplace. Sliding doors off the kitchen open to a sunny deck, perfect for morning coffee. Upstairs on the third level, you'll find a primary bedroom with ensuite bath and walk-in closet, plus a second generously sized bedroom that also boasts its own walk-in closet, along with a full hall bath. A stand-up attic offers excellent storage. Thoughtful updates run throughout the home, giving it a fresh, move-in-ready feel from top to bottom. A spacious garage, ample storage, and a laundry room round out the home's appeal. Residents of the community enjoy resort-style amenities, including a swimming pool, fitness center, and clubhouse, all set amid beautifully maintained grounds. Commuter-friendly address with easy access to shops, restaurants, Metro-North, I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.
